subject: Benchmark handoff protocol and results bundle
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ravi@lumenpay.com>
Date: 2027-12-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Benchmark run plan + acceptance targets (handoff)
Attachments: lumen_load_script.yaml, mutual_action_plan_v2.docx

Hi Amy / Ravi,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our onboarding checklist, we want to lock the benchmarking plan so your SREs and our bench team run a representative acceptance test before we flip traffic. Core asks below — please confirm and share the point-of-contact for the generator and network config.

Targets (baseline acceptance):
- P50 latency: < 80 ms (inference only)
- P95 latency: < 220 ms
- P99 latency: < 400 ms (initial target; we’ll aim to lower this in tuning)
- Sustained throughput: >= 1000 req/s with 1.2s average request size (text-gen, seq=512)
- Error rate: < 0.2% (5xx and client errors)

Planned test window: 2027-12-11 02:00–06:00 PST (low traffic hours for LumenPay). We will run three 30-minute steady-state stages (burst, ramp, sustained) and a 60-minute soak at the end. 

Attachments: lumen_load_script.yaml (our load script + generator config), mutual_action_plan_v2.docx (responsibilities + rollback criteria).

Action items for LumenPay before the run:
- Confirm SRE contact and inbound/outbound IP allowlist for load generator.
- Provide test credentials or flag the dataset we should use.
- Confirm whether you want to use Redwood-hosted generator or your own.

If the above looks good I’ll loop in Monica (CSM) and Priya (performance lead) to coordinate the run and results delivery.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy@lumenpay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ravi@lumenpay.com>, LumenPay SRE <sre@lumenpay.com>
Date: 2027-12-10T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark run plan + acceptance targets (handoff)

Hi Mateo — thanks, this looks sensible.

We can do the window on 12/11 02:00–06:00 PST. SRE will use our internal generator unless Redwood prefers otherwise; we can provide test tokens and a subset of production traffic (obfuscated) — Ravi, can you share the dataset pointer and the generator IP range?

Quick Q: can Redwood accept LumenPay’s TLS-terminated test endpoint (fronted by our load balancer) rather than direct to the model pods? Our security team prefers testing through the same LB path we’ll use in prod.

SRE contact: Marco Li <sre@lumenpay.com> (cc’d). I’ll send a small creds file separately.

Amy Chen
Head of Ops, LumenPay
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@lumenpay.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-10T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark run plan + acceptance targets (handoff)

Thanks Amy — looping in our performance team. A couple of notes from the onboarding checklist: 

- If you run through your LB path that’s fine, but we’ll need a short one-minute warmup to populate KV caches before measuring stage steady-state numbers. Please confirm we can run a warmup with production-like prefixes.
- Ben will coordinate capacity sizing if the run indicates uplift is needed mid-soak.
- We’ll publish a short results packet within 6 hours after the run and propose mitigations if any thresholds are missed.

Please confirm "generator hosted by LumenPay" vs "Redwood generator" and share the allowlist. Small items to send before the run: generator IPs, test token (scoped), and whether the LB will rewrite headers or change client IPs (that affects our tracing).

On our side: Priya will run the analysis and attach the latency CSV and a short playbook.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@lumenpay.com>, Marco Li <sre@lumenpay.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-11T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Run results: 2027-12-11 02:00–06:00 PST (initial findings)
Attachments: latency_results_20271211.csv

Hi all — we completed the scheduled run with the LumenPay SRE generator (thanks Marco). Summary highlights and artifacts below. Full CSV attached.

What we ran (short):
- Config: sequence length 512, batch window 12 ms, token limit 1024, quantized model variant q4_1.
- Stages: 3 x 30-minute steady-state + 60-minute soak.

Summary results (inference-only numbers):
- P50: 68 ms
- P95: 198 ms
- P99: 460 ms
- Sustained throughput (soak): 1,080 req/s
- Error rate: 0.07%

Notes / observations:
- We see a clear tail spike around 03:22–03:31 during the soak — correlated with periodic KV cache misses when prefixes changed between generator instances. This pushed P99 above our initial target (460 ms).
- Batch window at 12 ms yielded good throughput but amplified tail variance when generator instances rebalanced.
- No networking packet loss observed; LB path preserved client IPs as requested.

Recommendations (next steps):
1) Reduce batch window to 8 ms and re-run focused 30-min soak to check P99 impact. Expected trade: slight drop in throughput (~3–5%) for better tail.
2) Enable KV prefix sticky routing for generator instances to reduce cache churn.
3) Consider a small reserved capacity bump (one additional GPU pool) if you require sustained P99 <= 350 ms for production SLA.

I’m attaching latency_results_20271211.csv with per-request timestamps and host tags — will upload a sanitized copy to the Drive folder shortly: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-lumenpay-onboard

If you agree to the focused re-run we can schedule it tonight and fast-turn the results. If LumenPay needs a formal acceptance packet and signoff, we can prepare a short DocuSign acceptance link and a one-page runbook describing the mitigation steps.

Thanks,
Priya
Performance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy@lumenpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marco Li <sre@lumenpay.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-12T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Run results: 2027-12-11 02:00–06:00 PST (initial findings)

Thanks Priya — very helpful. We accept the recommended mitigations. Please go ahead with the focused 30-min re-run tonight; Marco will coordinate generator stickiness and provide any additional hooks you need.

Acceptance clause (LumenPay internal): we’ll sign the acceptance packet if the re-run shows:
- Sustained throughput >= 1000 req/s
- P95 <= 220 ms
- P99 <= 350 ms

Please send the DocuSign link for formal signoff; otherwise we’ll consider this the technical acceptance checklist and move to traffic cutover pending capacity agreement.

Amy Chen
Head of Ops, LumenPay
